issues.where: dark foreground haze and wet ground at the bottom left (x 0-33%, y 67-100%)
issues.what: The smooth dark gradient in -a has become mottled in -b. Faint blotchy patches and soft steps show where the haze should fade evenly into the black ground.
issues.fix: Spend more bits on the dark low-luminance areas, or add light dither or grain to the haze before encoding so the gradient doesn't quantize.

issues.where: orange dust cloud on the right (x 67-100%, y 33-67%)
issues.what: In -b the dust is flatter and slightly blotchy, with soft tonal steps between zones. It has lost some of the layered wisps seen in -a. It still reads as dust.
issues.fix: Keep some grain or noise in the haze so the encoder holds the wisps instead of smoothing them into patches.

issues.where: glow on the inner cave wall, lower left of the lit arch (top left crop)
issues.what: The soft orange glow shows faint vertical streaks and steps in both -a and -b, and -b makes them a little more visible. They are visible only when zoomed.
issues.fix: Dither the glow gradient at the source.

issues.where: grey fog wall and rock face at the top right (x 67-100%, y 0-33%), and the darker rock at lower left
issues.what: Fine rock texture is slightly smoothed in -b and the dark hazy areas pick up a faint blocky look. The rock still reads as rock.
issues.fix: Add a little more bitrate to the dark textured rock areas.

issues.where: lava glow strands and the spider legs at the horizon, right side
issues.what: The thin lava streaks and the thin legs hold their shape. The edges of the glow haze are a little soft, and the dark-ground reflections are slightly smeared.
issues.fix: No change is needed beyond a small bitrate increase on this area.
